chunker.token_estimate: words*1.3 + CJK characters (heuristic, not a tokenizer)

vector_store.keyword_index: GIN on to_tsvector('simple', heading || content) + pg_trgm GIN on content
vector_store.eligibility: searchable_chunks view: approved current version, not canceled/archived, active source, inside validity window

shared.relevance: document-level, binary; any expected document counts

B0.name: Vector-only
B0.description: pgvector cosine top-k on the query embedding; semantic-only matches below 0.80 dropped

E1.name: Original hybrid (SQL RRF)
E1.description: search_knowledge_v2: vector leg + keyword leg (simple tsquery OR + ILIKE + exact identifiers), equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion k=60

parameters.query_analysis: visa-code normalisation, multilingual glossary (17 concepts), rarity-weighted lexical coverage

E2S.name: E2 + assistant evidence selection
E2S.note: ranks the <= 4 source documents the answer model would receive

retrieval-pilot-0.1.role: development set (used for tuning in Milestones 1-2.2: results optimistic)

retrieval-heldout-0.2.role: held-out test (frozen 2026-11-23 before its first evaluation; never used for tuning)

targets.local: repository working tree, in-memory index rebuilt from the public corpus snapshot with the production chunker and embedder
targets.production: deployed public search API (commit 7e647cd), real Supabase/pgvector index; latency includes network round-trip
